bash:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
# Build each package.
for dir in packages/*; do
  if [ -f "$dir/package.json" ]; then
    echo "build ${dir}" && bun run --cwd "$dir" build
  fi
done
export COUNT=$((1 + 2))
